A plan you can explain.

Rebound puts the earliest deadlines first. For matching deadlines, high-priority assignments go first. It splits work into sessions of at most 25 minutes without exceeding your daily study time.

Work that won’t fit before its due date stays visible. An overdue assignment can be scheduled today, but remains flagged. Tasks due beyond this week may need a later plan.

This is a scheduling tool, not an AI tutor. It doesn’t write homework, guess task duration, or promise better grades. You choose your estimates and can change them.

Your catch-up assignments stay in this browser’s local storage. Focus schedules and session history use cloud storage under a random device key; see the Focus privacy panel. There is no account or sync. Clearing browser data removes them; save a backup to keep a copy. Hosting providers still receive ordinary website requests.

Built for the CSC Back-to-School Hackathon with AI coding assistance. Sample assignments are fictional.
